name: Ample Chunk-Peeling Width Classes
summary: Ample classes that can be reduced to the empty family by deleting at most k concepts at each step while preserving ampleness.
parameters: Integer k >= 1. This hierarchy increases with k, P_1 = Damp, and its union is Amp.
comments: Sans-serif P_k bounds deletions in the given class; calligraphic maximum-parent decomposition levels are a different existing hierarchy.
